programs.title: Air Force One
programs.desc: When the US President's plane is hijacked by terrorists, the President must fight to save the lives of those on board, and stop an evil military general from being released from prison.

programs.title: The Mod Squad
programs.desc: Three teens are co-opted by the police into becoming undercover agents instead of going to prison. Julie is a former vagrant and heroin addict, Pete a rich kid gone wrong and Linc is a young arsonist. The police figure that with their street-cred the mod squad can get in places that more official cops can't. They are asked to get information on a teenage prostitution ring being run out of a downtown club.

programs.title: The Real Murders Of Atlanta
programs.desc: Twin daughters find their mother stabbed to death in their quaint suburban home, and the pressure for detectives to deliver justice is on.

programs.title: Rasputin - The Mad Monk
programs.desc: Rasputin, an evil monk, possessed with strange powers of healing, goes to St. Petersburg to fulfil his evil ambitions. He influences people using his powers and gains a place in the palace.

programs.title: Agatha Christie's Evil Under The Sun
programs.desc: Hercule Poirot is called in to investigate a case for an insurance company regarding an important diamond and discovers that it was bought for a wealthy, arrogant woman, who turns up dead on her honeymoon. (Peter Ustinov, James Mason).

programs.title: Antiques Downunder
programs.desc: Antiques DownUnder visits Douglas Stewart Fine Books to see treasures that were created 5 centuries apart; Gregory visits an Aladdin's cave of toys in the Blue Mountains.
